-- =============================================================================
-- FLASH CONSOLIDATED BIGQUERY SQL
-- Final Consumer: CV_COMP_FIN_FLASH_STATIC (xml_acc_cv_comp_fin_flash_static_tbl_wss_flash_sales)
-- Populated via: STP_WSS_FLASH_SALES (stored procedure) -> CV_COMP_FIN_FLASH
-- Generated by: DI HANA to BigQuery Consolidation and SQL Generation Agent
-- =============================================================================
--
-- RUNTIME PARAMETERS (all @-parameters; values supplied by caller):
--   @v_week_ending_from  STRING  -- YYYYMMDD; prior-week start boundary (from procedure V_WEEK_ENDING_FROM_DATE)
--   @v_week_ending_to    STRING  -- YYYYMMDD; prior-week end boundary   (from procedure V_WEEK_ENDING_TO_DATE)
--   @v_upd_ts_from       STRING  -- YYYYMMDDHHMMSS numeric-string; update-timestamp lower bound (from procedure V_UPDATE_TIMESTAMP_FROM)
--   @v_upd_ts_to         STRING  -- YYYYMMDDHHMMSS numeric-string; update-timestamp upper bound (from procedure V_UPDATE_TIMESTAMP_TO)
--   @ip_version          STRING  -- Comp-flag version; default derived from SFN_ACTUALS_COMP_FLAG (unresolved scalar function)
--
-- PARAMETER DERIVATION NOTES (from STP_WSS_FLASH_SALES):
--   The procedure computes date boundaries at runtime using HANA WEEKDAY() semantics
--   (Monday=0 ... Sunday=6). In BigQuery the equivalent is:
--     V_ADJ = MOD(EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM CURRENT_DATE()) + 5, 7)
--     @v_week_ending_from = FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL (8 + V_ADJ) DAY))
--     @v_week_ending_to   = FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL (2 + V_ADJ) DAY))
--     @v_upd_ts_from      = CONCAT(FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL (9 + V_ADJ) DAY)), '091401')
--     @v_upd_ts_to        = CONCAT(FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', CURRENT_DATE()), '230000')
--   These are documented for the caller; they are NOT computed inside this query.
--
-- ISSUES TO FIX (see Consolidation Description for full details):
--   1. FLASH_SALES_VT_CAR: No matching row in Columns_Mapping_v3. BQ_FULL_TABLE unknown.
--      Placeholder: `REQUIRES_VALIDATION.FLASH_SALES_VT_CAR.UNMAPPED`
--   2. /POSDW/TLOGF: No matching row in Columns_Mapping_v3. BQ_FULL_TABLE unknown.
--      Placeholder: `REQUIRES_VALIDATION.POSDW_TLOGF.UNMAPPED`
--   3. /POSDW/TLOGF_X: No matching row in Columns_Mapping_v3. BQ_FULL_TABLE unknown.
--      Placeholder: `REQUIRES_VALIDATION.POSDW_TLOGF_X.UNMAPPED`
--   4. /POSDW/NAVIX: No matching row in Columns_Mapping_v3. BQ_FULL_TABLE unknown.
--      Placeholder: `REQUIRES_VALIDATION.POSDW_NAVIX.UNMAPPED`
--   5. ZTFIRP_FLASH_PRM: No matching row in Columns_Mapping_v3. BQ_FULL_TABLE unknown.
--      Placeholder: `REQUIRES_VALIDATION.ZTFIRP_FLASH_PRM.UNMAPPED`
--   6. @ip_version: Derived from unresolved scalar function SFN_ACTUALS_COMP_FLAG.
--      Caller must supply this parameter at runtime.
--   7. Column datatypes for /POSDW/TLOGF, /POSDW/TLOGF_X, /POSDW/NAVIX, ZTFIRP_FLASH_PRM,
--      and FLASH_SALES_VT_CAR are not in Columns_Mapping_v3; filter literal types require
--      validation once physical schemas are confirmed.
--   8. xml_acc_cv_base_tlogf-EMP_DISCOUNT (CV_BASE_TLOGF) dependency: The lineage marks
--      this relationship as inferred (score 75, Requires Validation). The EMP_DISCOUNT
--      branch uses the same CV_BASE_TLOGF source as FS_SALES/FS_DISCOUNT/RX_SALES.
--      Confirm whether a separate EMP_DISCOUNT-specific TLOGF view exists.
-- =============================================================================

WITH

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 1: FLASH
-- Logic: Reads raw flash sales data from the CAR base view (CV_BASE_FIN_FLASH_SALES_CAR),
--        which sources FLASH_SALES_VT_CAR. Applies the procedure's update-timestamp
--        window filter (ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP between @v_upd_ts_from and @v_upd_ts_to) and
--        the BUSINESSDAYDATE week range filter (@v_week_ending_from / @v_week_ending_to).
--        Excludes store IDs in the range '0000020000'–'0000024999'.
--        Computes CAL_WEEK_ENDING_DATE using HANA weekday-to-Saturday logic.
-- Source: REQUIRES_VALIDATION.FLASH_SALES_VT_CAR.UNMAPPED
--         (HANA: CVS_FRIP.FLASH_SALES_VT_CAR via CV_BASE_FIN_FLASH_SALES_CAR)
-- Filters:
--   ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP >= @v_upd_ts_from AND ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP <= @v_upd_ts_to
--   BUSINESSDAYDATE >= @v_week_ending_from AND BUSINESSDAYDATE <= @v_week_ending_to
--   RETAILSTOREID < '0000020000' OR RETAILSTOREID > '0000024999'
-- Calculation: CAL_WEEK_ENDING_DATE = next Saturday from BUSINESSDAYDATE (HANA weekday logic)
-- =====================================================================
FLASH AS (
  SELECT
    MANDT,
    BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    FS_SALESAMOUNT,
    REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    RX_SALESAMOUNT,
    CAL_FS_UNITS,
    EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_NS,
    CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_RE,
    RETAILSTOREID AS RETAILSTOREID_CAR,
    CAL_RX_CNT_NS,
    CAL_RX_CNT_RE,
    RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    SCRIPTS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    TRANSCURRENCY,
    CVD_AMOUNT,
    CAL_CVD_UNITS,
    -- CAL_WEEK_ENDING_DATE: advance BUSINESSDAYDATE to the Saturday of its week
    -- HANA: add_days(date, 5 - replace(weekday(date),6,-1))
    -- BigQuery weekday: MOD(EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM date)+5,7) gives Mon=0..Sun=6
    -- When weekday=6 (Sunday), HANA replace gives -1, so offset = 5-(-1) = 6
    FORMAT_DATE(
      '%Y%m%d',
      DATE_ADD(
        PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', BUSINESSDAYDATE),
        INTERVAL (
          5 - CASE
            WHEN MOD(EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', BUSINESSDAYDATE)) + 5, 7) = 6
              THEN -1
            ELSE MOD(EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', BUSINESSDAYDATE)) + 5, 7)
          END
        ) DAY
      )
    ) AS CAL_WEEK_ENDING_DATE
  FROM `REQUIRES_VALIDATION.FLASH_SALES_VT_CAR.UNMAPPED`
  -- Procedure filter: update-timestamp window
  WHERE ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP >= @v_upd_ts_from
    AND ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP <= @v_upd_ts_to
    -- CV_COMP_FIN_FLASH filter: BUSINESSDAYDATE in week range
    AND BUSINESSDAYDATE >= @v_week_ending_from
    AND BUSINESSDAYDATE <= @v_week_ending_to
    -- CV_COMP_FIN_FLASH filter: exclude store range 20000-24999
    AND (RETAILSTOREID < '0000020000' OR RETAILSTOREID > '0000024999')
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 2: RETAIL_CALENDAR
-- Logic: Reads retail calendar dimension from ZTFIGL_RCALWEEK, filtered to
--        clients '120' and '200'. Provides week/year/period attributes for
--        joining on CAL_WEEK_ENDING_DATE = ZRWENDDATE.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztfigl_rcalweek
-- Filters: rclnt IN ('120', '200')
-- =====================================================================
RETAIL_CALENDAR AS (
  SELECT
    rclnt,
    zzweek,
    zryear,
    zrperiod,
    zryrp,
    zrwenddate,
    zrwstrtdate
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztfigl_rcalweek`
  WHERE rclnt IN ('120', '200')
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 3: WEEK
-- Logic: Left joins FLASH to RETAIL_CALENDAR on CAL_WEEK_ENDING_DATE = zrwenddate
--        to enrich each flash sales row with week/year/period attributes.
-- Source: FLASH (CTE 1), RETAIL_CALENDAR (CTE 2)
-- Join: LEFT JOIN RETAIL_CALENDAR ON FLASH.CAL_WEEK_ENDING_DATE = RETAIL_CALENDAR.zrwenddate
-- =====================================================================
WEEK AS (
  SELECT
    rc.zzweek,
    rc.zryear,
    rc.zrperiod,
    rc.zryrp,
    rc.zrwenddate,
    rc.zrwstrtdate,
    f.MANDT,
    f.BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    f.FS_SALESAMOUNT,
    f.REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    f.RX_SALESAMOUNT,
    f.CAL_FS_UNITS,
    f.EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    f.CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_NS,
    f.CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_RE,
    f.CAL_WEEK_ENDING_DATE,
    f.CAL_RX_CNT_NS,
    f.CAL_RX_CNT_RE,
    f.RETAILSTOREID_CAR,
    f.RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    f.FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    f.SCRIPTS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    f.ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    f.TRANSCURRENCY,
    f.CVD_AMOUNT,
    f.CAL_CVD_UNITS
  FROM FLASH f
  LEFT JOIN RETAIL_CALENDAR rc
    ON f.CAL_WEEK_ENDING_DATE = rc.zrwenddate
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 4: COMP_FLAG
-- Logic: Reads comp-flag data from ZTSRP_COMPFL, filtered to the runtime
--        version parameter @ip_version. Provides FS_COMP_WK and RX_COMP_WK
--        for joining on PRCTR and week.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_compfl
-- Filters: comp_ver = @ip_version
-- =====================================================================
COMP_FLAG AS (
  SELECT
    mandt,
    prctr,
    strnum,
    comp_ver,
    fs_comp_wk,
    rx_comp_wk,
    zweek
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_compfl`
  WHERE comp_ver = @ip_version
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 5: HIERARCHY
-- Logic: Reads profit-center hierarchy from HRRP_NODE. Filters to nodes
--        whose parent matches *CORE_RET* and validity end = '99991231'.
--        Used to inner-join and restrict to core retail profit centers.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_hrrp_node
-- Filters: REGEXP_CONTAINS(parnode, r'.*CORE_RET.*') AND hryvalto = '99991231'
-- =====================================================================
HIERARCHY AS (
  SELECT
    parnode,
    hryvalto,
    mandt,
    nodevalue
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_hrrp_node`
  WHERE REGEXP_CONTAINS(parnode, r'.*CORE_RET.*')
    AND hryvalto = '99991231'
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 6: STORE_ATTR
-- Logic: Reads store attribute master data from ZTSRP_ATTR_ACT. Provides
--        dimensional attributes (geography, org hierarchy, dates) for
--        joining on store number (STRNUM = RETAILSTOREID_CAR).
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_attr_act
-- =====================================================================
STORE_ATTR AS (
  SELECT
    mandt,
    strnum,
    prctr,
    emerg_mkt_ind,
    rep_mkt_code,
    rep_mkt_desc,
    division_code,
    division_desc,
    region_code,
    region_desc,
    district_code,
    district_desc,
    city,
    state,
    fs_open_dat,
    rx_open_dat,
    area_code,
    area_desc,
    rx_division_code,
    rx_area_code,
    rx_region_code,
    rx_district_code
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_attr_act`
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 7: Joined_Week_Store_Attributes
-- Logic: Left joins WEEK to STORE_ATTR on RETAILSTOREID_CAR = strnum to
--        enrich sales rows with store dimensional attributes and PRCTR.
-- Source: WEEK (CTE 3), STORE_ATTR (CTE 6)
-- Join: LEFT JOIN STORE_ATTR ON WEEK.RETAILSTOREID_CAR = STORE_ATTR.strnum
-- =====================================================================
Joined_Week_Store_Attributes AS (
  SELECT
    sa.prctr,
    sa.emerg_mkt_ind,
    sa.rep_mkt_code,
    sa.rep_mkt_desc,
    sa.division_code,
    sa.division_desc,
    sa.region_code,
    sa.region_desc,
    sa.district_code,
    sa.district_desc,
    sa.city,
    sa.state,
    sa.fs_open_dat,
    sa.rx_open_dat,
    sa.area_code,
    sa.area_desc,
    sa.rx_division_code,
    sa.rx_area_code,
    sa.rx_region_code,
    sa.rx_district_code,
    w.CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_RE,
    w.CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_NS,
    w.EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    w.CAL_FS_UNITS,
    w.RX_SALESAMOUNT,
    w.REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    w.FS_SALESAMOUNT,
    w.BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    w.MANDT,
    w.zzweek,
    w.zryear,
    w.zrperiod,
    w.zryrp,
    w.CAL_WEEK_ENDING_DATE,
    w.RETAILSTOREID_CAR AS RETAILSTOREID,
    w.CAL_RX_CNT_NS,
    w.CAL_RX_CNT_RE,
    w.zrwenddate,
    w.zrwstrtdate,
    w.RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    w.FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    w.SCRIPTS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    w.ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    w.TRANSCURRENCY,
    w.CVD_AMOUNT,
    w.CAL_CVD_UNITS
  FROM WEEK w
  LEFT JOIN STORE_ATTR sa
    ON w.RETAILSTOREID_CAR = sa.strnum
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 8: Joined_Core_Retail_Hierarchy
-- Logic: Inner joins Joined_Week_Store_Attributes to HIERARCHY on
--        PRCTR = nodevalue. This restricts the result to only profit
--        centers that belong to the CORE_RET hierarchy.
-- Source: Joined_Week_Store_Attributes (CTE 7), HIERARCHY (CTE 5)
-- Join: INNER JOIN HIERARCHY ON Joined_Week_Store_Attributes.prctr = HIERARCHY.nodevalue
-- =====================================================================
Joined_Core_Retail_Hierarchy AS (
  SELECT
    j.CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_RE,
    j.CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_NS,
    j.EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    j.CAL_FS_UNITS,
    j.RX_SALESAMOUNT,
    j.REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    j.FS_SALESAMOUNT,
    j.BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    j.MANDT,
    j.zzweek,
    j.zryear,
    j.zrperiod,
    j.zryrp,
    j.CAL_WEEK_ENDING_DATE,
    j.RETAILSTOREID,
    j.CAL_RX_CNT_NS,
    j.CAL_RX_CNT_RE,
    j.zrwenddate,
    j.zrwstrtdate,
    j.prctr,
    j.emerg_mkt_ind,
    j.rep_mkt_code,
    j.rep_mkt_desc,
    j.division_code,
    j.division_desc,
    j.region_code,
    j.region_desc,
    j.district_code,
    j.district_desc,
    j.city,
    j.state,
    j.fs_open_dat,
    j.rx_open_dat,
    j.RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    j.FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    j.SCRIPTS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    j.ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    j.TRANSCURRENCY,
    j.area_code,
    j.area_desc,
    j.CVD_AMOUNT,
    j.CAL_CVD_UNITS,
    j.rx_division_code,
    j.rx_area_code,
    j.rx_region_code,
    j.rx_district_code
  FROM Joined_Week_Store_Attributes j
  INNER JOIN HIERARCHY h
    ON j.prctr = h.nodevalue
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 9: Joined_Comp_Flag_Data
-- Logic: Left joins Joined_Core_Retail_Hierarchy to COMP_FLAG on
--        PRCTR and zzweek = zweek to bring in FS_COMP_WK and RX_COMP_WK.
-- Source: Joined_Core_Retail_Hierarchy (CTE 8), COMP_FLAG (CTE 4)
-- Join: LEFT JOIN COMP_FLAG ON prctr = prctr AND zzweek = zweek
-- =====================================================================
Joined_Comp_Flag_Data AS (
  SELECT
    j.CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_RE,
    j.CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_NS,
    j.EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    j.CAL_FS_UNITS,
    j.RX_SALESAMOUNT,
    j.REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    j.FS_SALESAMOUNT,
    j.BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    j.MANDT,
    j.zzweek,
    j.zryear,
    j.zrperiod,
    j.zryrp,
    j.CAL_WEEK_ENDING_DATE,
    j.RETAILSTOREID,
    j.CAL_RX_CNT_NS,
    j.CAL_RX_CNT_RE,
    j.zrwenddate,
    j.zrwstrtdate,
    j.prctr,
    j.emerg_mkt_ind,
    j.rep_mkt_code,
    j.rep_mkt_desc,
    j.division_code,
    j.division_desc,
    j.region_code,
    j.region_desc,
    j.district_code,
    j.district_desc,
    j.city,
    j.state,
    j.fs_open_dat,
    j.rx_open_dat,
    j.RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    j.FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    j.SCRIPTS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    j.ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    j.TRANSCURRENCY,
    j.area_code,
    j.area_desc,
    cf.fs_comp_wk,
    cf.rx_comp_wk,
    j.CVD_AMOUNT,
    j.CAL_CVD_UNITS,
    j.rx_division_code,
    j.rx_area_code,
    j.rx_region_code,
    j.rx_district_code
  FROM Joined_Core_Retail_Hierarchy j
  LEFT JOIN COMP_FLAG cf
    ON j.prctr = cf.prctr
   AND j.zzweek = cf.zweek
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 10: CALCULATIONS
-- Logic: Computes derived measures from Joined_Comp_Flag_Data:
--   CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3 = CAL_RX_CNT_NS + CAL_RX_CNT_RE + (CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_NS + CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_RE) * 2
--   CAL_COMP_FLAG = GREATEST(fs_comp_wk, rx_comp_wk) or '0' if NULL
--   CAL_WEEK_NUMBER = last 2 characters of zzweek
-- Source: Joined_Comp_Flag_Data (CTE 9)
-- Calculation:
--   CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3, CAL_COMP_FLAG (from GREATEST of comp flags), CAL_WEEK_NUMBER
-- =====================================================================
CALCULATIONS AS (
  SELECT
    CAL_RX_CNT_RE,
    CAL_RX_CNT_NS,
    CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_RE,
    CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_NS,
    EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    CAL_FS_UNITS,
    RX_SALESAMOUNT,
    REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    FS_SALESAMOUNT,
    rep_mkt_desc,
    rep_mkt_code,
    emerg_mkt_ind,
    rx_comp_wk,
    fs_comp_wk,
    CAL_WEEK_ENDING_DATE,
    zryrp,
    zrperiod,
    zryear,
    zzweek,
    BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    prctr,
    RETAILSTOREID,
    MANDT,
    division_code,
    division_desc,
    region_code,
    region_desc,
    district_code,
    district_desc,
    zrwenddate,
    zrwstrtdate,
    city,
    state,
    fs_open_dat,
    rx_open_dat,
    RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    SCRIPTS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    TRANSCURRENCY,
    area_code,
    area_desc,
    CVD_AMOUNT,
    CAL_CVD_UNITS,
    rx_division_code,
    rx_area_code,
    rx_region_code,
    rx_district_code,
    -- CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3: total 90-day adjusted script count
    CAL_RX_CNT_NS + CAL_RX_CNT_RE + (CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_NS + CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_RE) * 2
      AS CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3,
    -- CAL_COMP_FLAG: max of FS and RX comp flags, default '0' if both null
    CASE
      WHEN GREATEST(fs_comp_wk, rx_comp_wk) IS NULL THEN '0'
      ELSE GREATEST(fs_comp_wk, rx_comp_wk)
    END AS CAL_COMP_FLAG,
    -- CAL_WEEK_NUMBER: last 2 digits of fiscal week
    RIGHT(zzweek, 2) AS CAL_WEEK_NUMBER
  FROM Joined_Comp_Flag_Data
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 11: EMPLOYEE_DISCOUNT
-- Logic: Aggregates employee discount amounts by dimensional grain and
--        computes synthetic comp/non-comp profit center codes:
--          CAL_COMP_FLAG='1' -> '0000562075' (comp stores)
--          CAL_COMP_FLAG='0' -> '0000562076' (non-comp stores)
-- Source: CALCULATIONS (CTE 10)
-- Aggregation: SUM(EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT), MAX(RX/FS/SCRIPTS_UPD_TIMESTAMP)
--   grouped by all dimensional columns
-- Calculation: CAL_PRCTR derived from CAL_COMP_FLAG
-- =====================================================================
EMPLOYEE_DISCOUNT AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT) AS EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    zryrp,
    zrperiod,
    zryear,
    zzweek,
    BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    CAL_WEEK_ENDING_DATE,
    CAL_COMP_FLAG,
    CAL_WEEK_NUMBER,
    MANDT,
    zrwenddate,
    zrwstrtdate,
    city,
    state,
    district_code,
    district_desc,
    region_code,
    region_desc,
    rx_comp_wk,
    fs_comp_wk,
    fs_open_dat,
    rx_open_dat,
    prctr AS prctr_org,
    MAX(RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP) AS RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    MAX(FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP) AS FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    MAX(SCRIPTS_UPD_TIMESTAMP) AS SCRIPTS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    TRANSCURRENCY,
    area_code,
    area_desc,
    rx_division_code,
    rx_area_code,
    rx_region_code,
    rx_district_code,
    CASE
      WHEN CAL_COMP_FLAG = '1' THEN '0000562075'
      WHEN CAL_COMP_FLAG = '0' THEN '0000562076'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS CAL_PRCTR
  FROM CALCULATIONS
  GROUP BY
    zryrp,
    zrperiod,
    zryear,
    zzweek,
    BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    CAL_WEEK_ENDING_DATE,
    CAL_COMP_FLAG,
    CAL_WEEK_NUMBER,
    MANDT,
    zrwenddate,
    zrwstrtdate,
    city,
    state,
    district_code,
    district_desc,
    region_code,
    region_desc,
    rx_comp_wk,
    fs_comp_wk,
    fs_open_dat,
    rx_open_dat,
    prctr,
    ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    TRANSCURRENCY,
    area_code,
    area_desc,
    rx_division_code,
    rx_area_code,
    rx_region_code,
    rx_district_code
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 12: COMP_NONCOMP_STORE_ATTR
-- Logic: Reads store attributes for the two synthetic comp/non-comp
--        profit centers ('0000562075', '0000562076') from ZTSRP_ATTR_ACT.
--        Used to enrich employee-discount rows with store attributes.
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_attr_act
-- Filters: prctr IN ('0000562075', '0000562076')
-- =====================================================================
COMP_NONCOMP_STORE_ATTR AS (
  SELECT
    mandt,
    strnum,
    prctr,
    emerg_mkt_ind,
    rep_mkt_code,
    rep_mkt_desc,
    division_code,
    division_desc,
    region_code,
    region_desc,
    district_code,
    district_desc,
    city,
    state,
    area_code,
    area_desc,
    rx_division_code,
    rx_area_code,
    rx_region_code,
    rx_district_code
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_ztsrp_attr_act`
  WHERE prctr IN ('0000562075', '0000562076')
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 13: Joined_Employee_Discount_Store_Attributes
-- Logic: Left joins EMPLOYEE_DISCOUNT to COMP_NONCOMP_STORE_ATTR on
--        CAL_PRCTR = prctr to enrich employee-discount rows with store
--        attributes for the synthetic comp/non-comp profit centers.
--        STRNUM is mapped as RETAILSTOREID for the employee-discount branch.
-- Source: EMPLOYEE_DISCOUNT (CTE 11), COMP_NONCOMP_STORE_ATTR (CTE 12)
-- Join: LEFT JOIN COMP_NONCOMP_STORE_ATTR ON CAL_PRCTR = prctr
-- =====================================================================
Joined_Employee_Discount_Store_Attributes AS (
  SELECT
    ed.MANDT,
    ed.CAL_PRCTR AS prctr,
    ed.BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    ed.zzweek,
    ed.zryear,
    ed.zrperiod,
    ed.zryrp,
    ed.zrwenddate,
    ed.zrwstrtdate,
    ed.CAL_WEEK_NUMBER,
    ed.EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    sa.emerg_mkt_ind,
    sa.rep_mkt_code,
    sa.rep_mkt_desc,
    sa.division_code,
    sa.division_desc,
    sa.region_code,
    sa.region_desc,
    sa.district_code,
    sa.district_desc,
    sa.city,
    sa.state,
    ed.CAL_COMP_FLAG,
    ed.rx_comp_wk,
    ed.fs_comp_wk,
    sa.strnum,
    ed.CAL_WEEK_ENDING_DATE,
    ed.fs_open_dat,
    ed.rx_open_dat,
    ed.RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    ed.FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    ed.SCRIPTS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    ed.ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    ed.TRANSCURRENCY,
    sa.area_code,
    sa.area_desc,
    sa.rx_division_code,
    sa.rx_area_code,
    sa.rx_region_code,
    sa.rx_district_code
  FROM EMPLOYEE_DISCOUNT ed
  LEFT JOIN COMP_NONCOMP_STORE_ATTR sa
    ON ed.CAL_PRCTR = sa.prctr
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 14: Combined_Flash_And_Employee_Discount  (Union_1 in source)
-- Logic: Unions two branches:
--   Branch 1 (CALCULATIONS): sales rows with EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT = NULL
--   Branch 2 (Joined_Employee_Discount_Store_Attributes): employee-discount
--     rows with all sales/script/CVD measures = NULL; STRNUM as RETAILSTOREID
-- Source: CALCULATIONS (CTE 10), Joined_Employee_Discount_Store_Attributes (CTE 13)
-- =====================================================================
Combined_Flash_And_Employee_Discount AS (
  -- Branch 1: sales rows; employee discount nulled
  SELECT
    RETAILSTOREID,
    CAL_WEEK_ENDING_DATE,
    fs_comp_wk,
    rx_comp_wk,
    emerg_mkt_ind,
    rep_mkt_code,
    rep_mkt_desc,
    CAL_COMP_FLAG,
    division_code,
    division_desc,
    FS_SALESAMOUNT,
    REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    RX_SALESAMOUNT,
    CAL_FS_UNITS,
    CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_NS,
    CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_RE,
    CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3,
    CAL_RX_CNT_NS,
    CAL_RX_CNT_RE,
    MANDT,
    prctr,
    BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    zzweek,
    zryear,
    zrperiod,
    zryrp,
    region_code,
    region_desc,
    district_code,
    district_desc,
    zrwenddate,
    zrwstrtdate,
    CAL_WEEK_NUMBER,
    city,
    state,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    fs_open_dat,
    rx_open_dat,
    RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    SCRIPTS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    TRANSCURRENCY,
    area_code,
    area_desc,
    CVD_AMOUNT,
    CAL_CVD_UNITS,
    rx_division_code,
    rx_area_code,
    rx_region_code,
    rx_district_code
  FROM CALCULATIONS

  UNION ALL

  -- Branch 2: employee-discount rows; all sales/script/CVD measures nulled
  SELECT
    strnum AS RETAILSTOREID,
    CAL_WEEK_ENDING_DATE,
    fs_comp_wk,
    rx_comp_wk,
    emerg_mkt_ind,
    rep_mkt_code,
    rep_mkt_desc,
    CAL_COMP_FLAG,
    division_code,
    division_desc,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS FS_SALESAMOUNT,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS RX_SALESAMOUNT,
    CAST(NULL AS INT64)   AS CAL_FS_UNITS,
    CAST(NULL AS INT64)   AS CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_NS,
    CAST(NULL AS INT64)   AS CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_RE,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3,
    CAST(NULL AS INT64)   AS CAL_RX_CNT_NS,
    CAST(NULL AS INT64)   AS CAL_RX_CNT_RE,
    MANDT,
    prctr,
    BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    zzweek,
    zryear,
    zrperiod,
    zryrp,
    region_code,
    region_desc,
    district_code,
    district_desc,
    zrwenddate,
    zrwstrtdate,
    CAL_WEEK_NUMBER,
    city,
    state,
    EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    fs_open_dat,
    rx_open_dat,
    RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    SCRIPTS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    TRANSCURRENCY,
    area_code,
    area_desc,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS CVD_AMOUNT,
    CAST(NULL AS INT64)   AS CAL_CVD_UNITS,
    rx_division_code,
    rx_area_code,
    rx_region_code,
    rx_district_code
  FROM Joined_Employee_Discount_Store_Attributes
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 15: PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT
-- Logic: Reads profit center long text from CEPCT for language-independent
--        enrichment of PRCTR with PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT (ltext).
-- Source: edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_cepct
-- =====================================================================
PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT AS (
  SELECT
    mandt,
    prctr,
    ltext AS profit_center_text
  FROM `edp-qa-finstorage.edp_saps4_shared_cnsv.v_cepct`
),

-- =====================================================================
-- CTE 16: Join_5
-- Logic: Left joins Combined_Flash_And_Employee_Discount to
--        PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT on PRCTR to enrich all rows with
--        profit center description text.
-- Source: Combined_Flash_And_Employee_Discount (CTE 14), PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT (CTE 15)
-- Join: LEFT JOIN PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT ON prctr = prctr
-- =====================================================================
Join_5 AS (
  SELECT
    u.MANDT,
    u.RETAILSTOREID,
    u.prctr,
    u.BUSINESSDAYDATE,
    u.zzweek,
    u.zryear,
    u.zrperiod,
    u.zryrp,
    u.CAL_WEEK_ENDING_DATE,
    u.fs_comp_wk,
    u.rx_comp_wk,
    u.emerg_mkt_ind,
    u.rep_mkt_code,
    u.rep_mkt_desc,
    u.CAL_COMP_FLAG,
    u.division_code,
    u.division_desc,
    u.region_code,
    u.region_desc,
    u.district_code,
    u.district_desc,
    u.zrwenddate,
    u.zrwstrtdate,
    u.CAL_WEEK_NUMBER,
    u.city,
    u.state,
    u.FS_SALESAMOUNT,
    u.REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    u.RX_SALESAMOUNT,
    u.CAL_FS_UNITS,
    u.CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_NS,
    u.CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_RE,
    u.CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3,
    u.CAL_RX_CNT_NS,
    u.CAL_RX_CNT_RE,
    u.EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
    pct.profit_center_text,
    u.fs_open_dat,
    u.rx_open_dat,
    u.RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    u.FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    u.SCRIPTS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    u.ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
    u.TRANSCURRENCY,
    u.area_code,
    u.area_desc,
    u.CVD_AMOUNT,
    u.CAL_CVD_UNITS,
    u.rx_division_code,
    u.rx_area_code,
    u.rx_region_code,
    u.rx_district_code
  FROM Combined_Flash_And_Employee_Discount u
  LEFT JOIN PROFIT_CENTER_TEXT pct
    ON u.prctr = pct.prctr
)

-- =====================================================================
-- FINAL SELECT: CV_COMP_FIN_FLASH aggregation (dataCategory=CUBE)
-- Logic: Aggregates Join_5 per the CV_COMP_FIN_FLASH logical model
--        (CUBE/Aggregation). Groups by all 37 non-measure attributes;
--        applies SUM to additive measures and MAX to timestamp measures.
--        This is the output that STP_WSS_FLASH_SALES inserts into
--        TBL_WSS_FLASH_SALES, which CV_COMP_FIN_FLASH_STATIC then reads
--        and re-aggregates with the same grain.
-- Aggregation:
--   SUM: FS_SALESAMOUNT, REDUCTIONAMOUNT, RX_SALESAMOUNT, CAL_FS_UNITS,
--        CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_NS, CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_RE, CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3,
--        CAL_RX_CNT_NS, CAL_RX_CNT_RE, EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT, CVD_AMOUNT, CAL_CVD_UNITS
--   MAX: RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP, FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP, SCRIPTS_UPD_TIMESTAMP
-- =====================================================================
SELECT
  MANDT,
  RETAILSTOREID,
  prctr,
  BUSINESSDAYDATE,
  zzweek,
  zryear,
  zrperiod,
  zryrp,
  CAL_WEEK_ENDING_DATE,
  fs_comp_wk,
  rx_comp_wk,
  emerg_mkt_ind,
  rep_mkt_code,
  rep_mkt_desc,
  CAL_COMP_FLAG,
  division_code,
  division_desc,
  region_code,
  region_desc,
  district_code,
  district_desc,
  zrwenddate,
  zrwstrtdate,
  CAL_WEEK_NUMBER,
  city,
  state,
  profit_center_text,
  fs_open_dat,
  rx_open_dat,
  ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
  TRANSCURRENCY,
  area_code,
  area_desc,
  rx_division_code,
  rx_area_code,
  rx_region_code,
  rx_district_code,
  SUM(FS_SALESAMOUNT)       AS FS_SALESAMOUNT,
  SUM(REDUCTIONAMOUNT)      AS REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
  SUM(RX_SALESAMOUNT)       AS RX_SALESAMOUNT,
  SUM(CAL_FS_UNITS)         AS CAL_FS_UNITS,
  SUM(CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_NS)   AS CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_NS,
  SUM(CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_RE)   AS CAL_RX_CNT_GE84_RE,
  SUM(CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3)    AS CAL_SCRIPTS_90AS3,
  SUM(CAL_RX_CNT_NS)        AS CAL_RX_CNT_NS,
  SUM(CAL_RX_CNT_RE)        AS CAL_RX_CNT_RE,
  SUM(EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT)  AS EMP_REDUCTIONAMOUNT,
  MAX(RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP)     AS RX_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
  MAX(FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP)     AS FS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
  MAX(SCRIPTS_UPD_TIMESTAMP) AS SCRIPTS_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
  SUM(CVD_AMOUNT)           AS CVD_AMOUNT,
  SUM(CAL_CVD_UNITS)        AS CAL_CVD_UNITS
FROM Join_5
GROUP BY
  MANDT,
  RETAILSTOREID,
  prctr,
  BUSINESSDAYDATE,
  zzweek,
  zryear,
  zrperiod,
  zryrp,
  CAL_WEEK_ENDING_DATE,
  fs_comp_wk,
  rx_comp_wk,
  emerg_mkt_ind,
  rep_mkt_code,
  rep_mkt_desc,
  CAL_COMP_FLAG,
  division_code,
  division_desc,
  region_code,
  region_desc,
  district_code,
  district_desc,
  zrwenddate,
  zrwstrtdate,
  CAL_WEEK_NUMBER,
  city,
  state,
  profit_center_text,
  fs_open_dat,
  rx_open_dat,
  ZZ_UPD_TIMESTAMP,
  TRANSCURRENCY,
  area_code,
  area_desc,
  rx_division_code,
  rx_area_code,
  rx_region_code,
  rx_district_code
